_meta.label: SEED DATASET - DEMO ONLY
_meta.warning: Small illustrative seed written for demonstration. Not clinically reviewed, not complete, not a substitute for a licensed, clinician-reviewed drug knowledge base. Brand-to-generic mappings must be verified against current Indian product labels.

interactions.plain: Taking an ARB-type and an ACE-inhibitor-type blood pressure medicine together can raise potassium and strain the kidneys, and can drop blood pressure too low.
interactions.source: Class labeling for ARBs/ACE inhibitors (dual RAAS blockade warning) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Pain relievers such as diclofenac or ibuprofen can make some blood pressure medicines work less well and can strain the kidneys, especially in older people or people with diabetes.
interactions.source: Class labeling for ARBs (Drug Interactions: NSAIDs) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Pain relievers such as diclofenac or ibuprofen can make some blood pressure medicines work less well and can strain the kidneys.
interactions.source: Class labeling for ACE inhibitors (Drug Interactions: NSAIDs) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Warfarin together with aspirin can increase the chance of bleeding.
interactions.source: Warfarin prescribing information (Drug Interactions: antiplatelets/salicylates) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Warfarin together with pain relievers like diclofenac or ibuprofen can increase the chance of bleeding.
interactions.source: Warfarin prescribing information (Drug Interactions: NSAIDs) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Some antibiotics of the macrolide family can change how warfarin works, so blood tests may need closer attention.
interactions.source: Warfarin prescribing information (Drug Interactions: antibiotics) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Aspirin together with another pain reliever of the NSAID family can raise the chance of stomach bleeding.
interactions.source: NSAID class labeling (Drug Interactions: aspirin) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Some blood pressure medicines combined with spironolactone-type water tablets can raise potassium in the blood to unsafe levels.
interactions.source: Spironolactone / ARB / ACE inhibitor labeling (hyperkalemia warning) - seed summary

interactions.plain: Sildenafil-type medicines with nitrate heart medicines can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure.
interactions.source: Sildenafil prescribing information (Contraindications: nitrates) - seed summary
